Humans can stay in the loop, every step of the way, while focusing more of their time on strategy. Automated Control Testing Get real-time insight into evidence, control effectiveness, and issues. Stay audit-ready across 30+ frameworks. No-Code, Flexible Graph Database Eliminate surprises, connect siloed data, and quickly adapt your workflows as the risk landscape evolves. AI & Agents Opt-in AI skills and agents eliminate manual work, automate the everyday, and weave intelligence into GRC programs. Reporting & Insights Get real-time visibility of risk across your organization with board-level reporting dashboards. Risk Cloud Quantify® Quantify and communicate financial risks leveraging Monte Carlo simulations and the Open FAIR™ Model. Value Realization Tool Leverage existing data and cross-workflow calculation fields to unlock real-time value-tracking dashboards. Workflow Automation Automate manual processes to improve efficiency, reduce errors, and ensure timely task completion. Risk & Control Self Assessment Minimizes clicks while maximizing risk insights and operational resilience. Automated Gap Analysis Visually compare existing coverage to new or updated frameworks, auto-generate corrective action plans with AI, and track progress in real-time. View All Features From Risk Identification to Board Reporting on One Platform LogicGate operates across four continuous stages. Each stage feeds the next – automatically – because everything runs on the same connected data model. Map Your Process Map risks, controls, and approvals with no-code workflows – no IT required. Connect Your Data Connect 200+ integrations, including Workday, ServiceNow, and Jira to automate risk data flow. Automate Your Workflows Automate key risk tasks with LogicGate AI agents, so your team can focus on more strategic work. Manage Risk and Reporting with Confidence Generate board-ready risk reports from live data and share real-time insights. Data flows bidirectionally, so your risk program reflects the current state of your environment without manual imports. View All Integrations FRAMEWORKS 100+ Frameworks. Pre-Built. Always Current. LogicGate ships with 100+ pre-built regulatory frameworks – all maintained by LogicGate's regulatory intelligence team. When a framework is updated, your control mappings and compliance posture update automatically. No manual rework.
